question: Kumari Kamala was awarded with Padma Bhushan in 1970. She was recognized for which classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kumari Kamala** was a renowned** Bharatanatyam dancer, choreographer** and** teacher** from India.
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the **oldest classical dance forms** of India, with its origins in the temples of **Tamil Nadu.**</li&
